alert: Error rate above 5% on frontend checkout requests

root_cause.summary: The payment service is rejecting checkout requests with an authentication failure (invalid token), causing a high error rate observed on frontend checkout. Traces, logs, and metrics all point to payment as the source, while the product-catalog restart is unrelated.
